comment: Throwable rubble (docs/DAMAGE.md 'Ledge cling and throwable rubble'), Godot-only overlay data gated on Combat.tuning_active(); the destructible mode is offline only, so rubble never spawns online. When a breakable prop shatters (docs/DESTRUCTIBLE.md) one chunk of it stays on the floor as a pickup: SHOVE next to it picks it up, FIRE throws it at the crosshair, SHOVE while holding puts it down. A thrown chunk is a light projectile resolved through the shared Combat.hit path by the thrower (no protocol message). damage/force are the hit; speed = throw speed (m/s) and up = fixed upward speed when thrown without a target point; gravity/life = flight and ground lifetime (s); pickupRange = metres; maxChunks = live chunks (oldest resting one is recycled); radius = chunk collision size, hitRadius = extra reach of a flying chunk against a fighter; cooldown = seconds between a pickup and the next one; bot.grab/throwMin/throwMax = how far a bot walks to a chunk and the window it throws one in; bot.think = seconds between a bot's rubble decisions.
